Run a claim-scoped diagnostic audit

Source: R/csdg_audit.R, R/csdg_documentation.R
csdg_audit.Rd

Derives the gate plan of the claim (csdg_gate_plan()) and computes the diagnostics of the gates in the plan: held-out performance (G1), dependence and observed support (G2), calibration (G3a), decision curves (G3b), cross-fitted local fidelity (G4), stability of held-out PFI (G5), comparison with similarly accurate models (G6a), leave-one-setting-out refits (G6b), and subgroup results (G7a); G0a and G0b check the claim and measurement cards, and G7b records user evidence supplied in evidence. Required gates are computed; held-out performance is also computed when it is context for the claim (a model description) or when a required gate uses its fold models. Each gate result has a property status: "supported" or "contradicted" under a criterion with a recorded source and rationale, "open" if the criterion or evidence is missing, "not_required" if the gate was not run, or "error". The audit cannot judge whether the procedure computes the quantity that the claim names, so G2 is "open" until the researcher records it with csdg_evidence_record(); csdg_claim_report() accepts such records.

Usage

csdg_audit(
  task,
  learner,
  claim,
  measurement,
  explanation = NULL,
  config = csdg_config(),
  resampling = NULL,
  candidate_learners = NULL,
  setting_group = NULL,
  subgroup = NULL,
  local_cases = NULL,
  pfi_strata = NULL,
  pfi_cluster = NULL,
  pfi_cluster_level_groups = NULL,
  evidence = list(),
  run_gates = NULL,
  output_dir = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

task

An mlr3::Task.

learner

The mlr3::Learner to audit, with preprocessing embedded in its pipeline.

claim

A CSDGClaim object.

measurement

A CSDGMeasurement object.

explanation

A CSDGExplanation object or NULL.

config

A CSDGConfig object.

resampling

An mlr3::Resampling or CSDGGroupedResampling object.

candidate_learners

Optional candidates for model-generalization checks.

setting_group

Optional setting labels for leave-one-setting-out refits.

subgroup

Optional row-id-keyed subgroup audit data.

local_cases

Prespecified local cases.

pfi_strata

Optional row-aligned strata within which PFI donors are permuted.

pfi_cluster

Optional row-aligned assessment-cluster identifiers.

pfi_cluster_level_groups

Optional feature-group names whose values are permuted coherently at cluster level.

evidence

Named external gate evidence (lists with status, summary, and optional criterion fields, or CSDGGateResult objects), keyed by gate identifier; audience_evidence supplies user evidence for G7b.

run_gates

Optional gate ids to execute. This controls computation but does not change which gates the claim requires.

output_dir

Optional bundle-export directory.

...

Explicit aliases or additional runner inputs accepted by csdg_audit().

Value

A CSDGResult object.

Details

Individual gate errors are retained in the report card so that one failure does not erase other diagnostic evidence.
